kultivator.screen.help.jalan.title: The Path tablet
kultivator.screen.help.jalan: The Path tablet (/cultivate jalan) has three sections. First Steps: 20 steps in 5 chapters, from testing your root to bringing home a first expedition. The tracker on the right edge of the screen always shows the next step and how to do it; it shrinks to a seal after 20 s and opens again on a change or while you hold [[key:quick]]. Steps you did before are ticked at once. Every finished chapter gives one reward (pills, spirit stones, a jade slip, a talisman) through the Claim reward talisman. The tracker coin in Settings › HUD hides it. Foundation Trials: from Foundation Establishment every major breakthrough has three optional trials; each finished trial gives +0.07 quality to that breakthrough, all three a further +0.05 and strikes ×0.9 (Firm Foundation). Nothing is mandatory. Source: Inspired by Yao Lao guiding Xiao Yan and the Foundation Elixirs he refines "tailored for you" (Battle Through the Heavens ch. 20); the trials Inspired by the graded Foundations of I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 76 and 100 and A Will Eternal. The steps and trials are game design.
kultivator.screen.help.harian.title: Daily Chores
kultivator.screen.help.harian: Daily Chores (/cultivate harian): every in-game day brings three small tasks of your own, such as killing monsters, meditating without a break, mining gold, diamond or emerald ores without Silk Touch, or harvesting spirit herbs. New chores also need 15 minutes of play since the last ones, so sleeping through nights brings none. Each chore gives 4%% of your cultivation bar, all three a Low Spirit Stone, and every day in a row with all three done adds 10%%, up to +50%%; a missed day starts the count again. Three dots beside the realm name on the HUD show the progress. They are separate from the disciples' Sect Duties and the Mission board. Source: Renegade Immortal ch. 10 (as a servant disciple Wang Lin must fill no fewer than ten vats of water a day). The streak bonus is game design.
kultivator.screen.help.persiapan.title: Preparation and the tribulation HUD
kultivator.screen.help.persiapan: With the bar full at a bottleneck, the Preparation coin on the Status tab shows the forecast of your next breakthrough. Qi Refining to Foundation: the success chance with its parts (base 75%%, root, pill, Stored Qi) and a tip about spiritual sites. A tribulation: the number of strikes, the share of your health each takes (the last one double, ×1.5 from Immortal Ascension), the total and how much healing you need; the quality bonus from Foundation Trials, spirit stones in the offhand and Hu Fa guardians; whether a Heart Demon comes first; the Dao Protector waves; lightning rings from Nascent Soul; and a checklist (health, healing, warding, allies, toxicity, Qi Deviation). During a tribulation the HUD on the left edge shows strike pips, the time to the next strike, the hearts it will take (flashing red when it would make you fail), the lightning ring at your feet and a small map of the 6-block limit. Source: game design (UX); it only reads existing systems.
